Our Story

Built From the Ground Up. Blessed by God Along the Way.

CMD Woodworking began long before we ever imagined having a woodworking business. Our journey started with a dream of building our own log cabin.

And when we say we built it ourselves, we don’t mean we hired contractors and watched the work happen. We mean laying every block, placing every log, and building our home with our own hands, one piece at a time.

What began as a necessity gradually became a hobby, and that hobby grew into something we truly love doing.

Looking back, we can see God’s hand in every step of our journey. Through hard work, determination, and His many blessings, what started as building a home has grown into a small, family-centered woodworking business.

Our children have been a big part of this journey, and we believe that family, faith, and the gifts God has given us are at the heart of everything we create.

We especially love making custom wooden signs and detailed 3D carvings with our CNC machines. Whether it’s a simple personalized sign or an intricate three-dimensional design, we enjoy the challenge of bringing an idea to life.

From the first drawing and computer programming to the final finishing touches, we approach every project with patience, creativity, and pride in our craftsmanship. We believe that with faith, determination, and a willingness to learn, no project is too challenging to design, program, or create.

We don’t take credit for this journey alone. We thank God for the opportunities, the abilities, and the many blessings He has given us.

Our hope is that every piece we create will bring joy to someone’s home, become part of their family’s story, and perhaps even be passed down through generations.

At CMD Woodworking, we build with our hands, create with our hearts, and give God the glory.
